```yaml
name: C# GSDK Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'csharp/**'
      - '.github/workflows/csharp-tests.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update .csproj files to .NET 10
        run: |
          sed -i 's/<TargetFramework>net6.0<\/TargetFramework>/<TargetFramework>net10.0<\/TargetFramework>/g' csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj
          sed -i 's/<TargetFramework>net8.0<\/TargetFramework>/<TargetFramework>net10.0<\/TargetFramework>/g' csharp/WinTestRunnerGame/WinTestRunnerGame.csproj
          sed -i 's/<TargetFramework>netcoreapp2.1<\/TargetFramework>/<TargetFramework>net10.0<\/TargetFramework>/g' csharp/WindowsTestAppCSharp/WindowsTestAppCSharp.csproj

      - name: Setup .NET 10.0 SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: dotnet test csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal
```
